"import csv
from docx import Document

CSV_PATH = "load_03.csv"
OUT_PATH = "report.docx"
COLUMNS = ["case", "load_factor", "cycles"]


def fmt_num(x, nd=2):
    """Round to nd decimals and strip trailing zeros ('1.70' -> '1.7')."""
    s = f"{round(x, nd):.{nd}f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
    return s if s else "0"


def main():
    # ---- Read CSV, preserving raw strings for exact source formatting ----
    with open(CSV_PATH, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
        rows = [r for r in csv.reader(f) if any(c.strip() for c in r)]

    header = [h.strip() for h in rows[0]]
    data_rows = rows[1:]

    # Map required column names to CSV column indices (case-insensitive).
    lookup = {}
    for i, h in enumerate(header):
        lookup.setdefault(h.lower(), i)
    col_idx = [lookup.get(c.lower(), COLUMNS.index(c)) for c in COLUMNS]

    n = len(data_rows)
    table_rows = [
        [(row[i].strip() if i < len(row) else "") for i in col_idx]
        for row in data_rows
    ]

    # ---- Compute all numeric claims from the data ----
    loads = [float(r[1]) for r in table_rows]
    cycles = [int(float(r[2])) for r in table_rows]

    n_disp = str(n)
    max_disp = fmt_num(max(loads), 2)
    mean_disp = fmt_num(sum(loads) / n, 2)
    total_disp = str(sum(cycles))

    # ---- Build the document ----
    doc = Document()
    doc.add_heading("Engineering Test Report — Load Case 03", 0)

    # Overview
    doc.add_heading("Overview", 1)
    doc.add_paragraph(
        f"This report summarizes the cyclic load test data recorded in "
        f"load_03.csv. The dataset contains N = {n_disp} data rows "
        f"(data records excluding the header row)."
    )

    # Results table
    doc.add_heading("Results table", 1)
    table = doc.add_table(rows=1 + n, cols=3)
    try:
        table.style = "Table Grid"
    except Exception:
        pass
    for j, name in enumerate(COLUMNS):
        cell = table.rows[0].cells[j]
        cell.text = name
        for p in cell.paragraphs:
            for run in p.runs:
                run.bold = True
    for i, row_vals in enumerate(table_rows, start=1):
        for j, val in enumerate(row_vals):
            table.rows[i].cells[j].text = val

    # Summary (exact computed values)
    doc.add_heading("Summary", 1)
    doc.add_paragraph(
        f"N cases = {n_disp}. Load max = {max_disp}. "
        f"Load mean = {mean_disp}. Total cycles = {total_disp}."
    )

    # Conclusion
    doc.add_heading("Conclusion", 1)
    doc.add_paragraph(
        f"All {n_disp} records from load_03.csv were tabulated without "
        f"modification, and every figure cited in this report was computed "
        f"directly from those values. The results table above reproduces the "
        f"source data with its original rounding, providing a traceable "
        f"record for the load case 03 engineering assessment."
    )

    doc.save(OUT_PATH)
    print(f"Wrote {OUT_PATH}: N={n_disp}, max={max_disp}, "
          f"mean={mean_disp}, total_cycles={total_disp}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()"
